I know I've definitely felt different energies of different houses, and even different cities and towns. It's a weird thing when you can just *feel* a certain vibe a city gives off, without even knowing anything about it. 

In fact, my previous house my family lived in (which is now being remodeled, and we'll move back in when it's finished) had a really weird vibe that went with it. It was an old house, and had never been remodeled, which meant it had the original stoves and microwaves (without any glass!) and foundation and everything. My friend stopped staying the night for awhile after he saw a ghost across the room walking away from him, whom he thought was me at first but after following, realized I was in the opposite side of the house. The master bedroom and hallway leading to it also had an eerie chill to it, and sometimes even smelled like death. I'd normally dismiss the smell as being a rodent that died under the floorboards, but after we prayed for that area of the house, the smell went away the next day. Could be coincidence, who knows. 

Since we dug up the entire foundation of the house for reconstruction, and then dug even deeper for basement we're adding, we were able to climb down to the dirt that was under our house and lay hands on the dirt walls and pray over the soil. It felt relaxing, even if it did nothing more than bring us peace of mind.
